Matches Go: `--depth N` (with `missing value for --depth` and `invalid depth: <cause>`), `--json`, `unknown flag` usage as `webb ax-tree ...`, and `failed to get accessibility tree: <cause>` on query failure. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (tree, JSON, invalid depth, unknown flag)

The dead `browser.close` in its ensure is gone (Go's withPage never closes; Crystal's exit skips ensure). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: same URL handling (`http://` for a schemeless host, `about:blank` when empty, wait_load only for a real URL), index lookup by target id with the Pages() error ignored like `pages, _ :=`, `%v` connect fatal, `failed to save state: <cause>`, and the `Opened [%d] %s` line only when Info succeeds. MustPage/MustWaitLoad failures escape as exceptions like every Go Must*. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (blank page, schemeless URL, new page becomes active, unreachable browser)
Go's structure: own load/connect/list, creates a page at the URL when none are open (saving active_page 0), otherwise navigates the active page. Both branches covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: parses the index before loading state and fatals `invalid index: <cause>`, keeps `page index %d out of range (0-%d)`, fatals per step (`%v` for state/connect, `failed to list pages: <cause>`, `failed to save state: <cause>`), and prints the switch line only when Info succeeds. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (non-numeric index before any session, usage, out of range, switching 0 then 1 with the saved active page, and an unreachable browser)

Matches Go: `*` marks the active page, inactive lines keep Go's marker-plus-space prefix, a page whose Info fails prints `(unknown)` instead of aborting, the listing failure fatals `failed to list pages: <cause>`, and state/connect failures fatal with their own cause (the connect wrapper belongs to connectBrowser's row). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (missing/corrupt state, stale connect, one page, active marker across two pages) and spec/webb_spec.cr (.format_page_list and .page_info? with stub pages)

Matches Go: `missing value for <flag>` echoes the flag actually used, `invalid width/height` fatal on bad numerics (64-bit like Go's int), and viewport/screenshot/write failures fatal with Go's messages. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr including a live screenshot

Matches Go: selector and value are quoted as JS literals (Go %q, Crystal to_json), `select failed: ...` covers eval errors, and the returned value prints without JSON quoting. Covered for quoted values and missing selectors by spec/cli_spec.cr
Matches Go: non-numeric seconds fatal with `invalid seconds: ...` and exit 2, and a negative duration sleeps for no time. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go end to end: flag validation, single-process launcher flags, live-session close, stale state left in place, `failed to save state`, and the two output lines. Divergence: Crystal accepts the advertised `--show` that upstream rejects (plans/parity.md). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr start examples

Matches Go: any loadState error (missing or corrupt) prints `No active browser session` and exits 0 via Webb.load_state?, an unreachable browser prints `Browser not responding (PID N, state may be stale)` and exits 0, a listing failure degrades to Pages: 0, and the running session echoes the saved PID/URL, page count, active page, and `Current: <title> - <url>`. All four paths covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: no-session fatal from loadState, closes only a browser we launched (chrome_pid > 0), TERMs the PID when it cannot connect, TERMs the proxy helper, removes state, and always prints `Chrome stopped`. Covered for external, stale, and owned sessions by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: the element check fatals with `form not found: ...` and the selector is quoted as a JS literal. An eval failure surfaces as an unhandled exception, the same treatment every Go Must* call gets in this port
